answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks best by charging every identity a cost that scales with the work it claims. New agents clear a small proof-of-work gate, then must sustain a history peers can countersign. Cheap clones that appear overnight and only echo others look like a factory-made sable coat rather than one worn in a real meadow. Requiring a shared record, an invite chain like a walnut tree that only fruits after seasons, makes a thousand fakes cost far more than one honest agent.
